literal: Is the body of him who shields his family from faults indeed a vessel for receiving affliction?
translation: Is the body of a person who constantly shields their family from faults and ruin merely a vessel destined to hold suffering?
modern: தன் குடும்பத்திற்கு வரும் குற்றங்களை நீக்கப் பாடுபடுபவனுடைய உடம்பு, துன்பங்களை மட்டுமே தாங்கும் ஒரு பாத்திரமோ?
explanation: This couplet highlights the immense self-sacrifice of an individual who dedicates their life to protecting and uplifting their family. Such a person constantly faces hardships and struggles to shield their family from faults and ruin. The poet rhetorically asks if their very body is meant to be a vessel ('kolkalam') solely for containing suffering ('idumbai'), emphasizing that their life is defined by enduring pain for the sake of their family's honor.
